title: Seeking the Will of God
description: A lesson on how believers can know and follow the will of God.

cards.heading: God Has a Purpose for Every Life
cards.body: God has a plan and purpose for every believer. His will is not hidden from those who sincerely seek Him.
cards.question: Do you believe God has a specific purpose for your life?

cards.heading: God Reveals His Will to His People
cards.scriptureText: My sheep listen to my voice.
cards.body: Christ reveals His will to those who belong to Him. True believers can hear His voice through Scripture and spiritual guidance.
cards.question: How do you recognize God’s voice in your life?

cards.heading: God Speaks Through His Word
cards.scriptureText: Your word is a lamp for my feet.
cards.body: The primary way God reveals His will is through His Word. A believer must stay close to Christ and listen carefully.
cards.question: How often do you seek guidance from Scripture before making decisions?

cards.heading: God Guides Through the Holy Spirit
cards.scriptureText: Those who are led by the Spirit of God are the children of God.
cards.body: The Holy Spirit guides believers in ways that never contradict God’s Word.
cards.question: Have you experienced the Holy Spirit’s guidance in a decision?

cards.heading: God Reveals His Will to the Obedient
cards.body: God reveals His will most clearly to those who are ready to obey, even when obedience requires sacrifice.
cards.question: Are you willing to obey God even when it is difficult?
